questionReview.note: Both Q1 alternatives correspond and are retained: company A and manufacturing company B each have combined final accounts 75 and balance sheet 45. Paper 2–5 and scheme 3–9 match all adjustments. Q1B balance sheet uses building value 1,300,000 although the paper states revaluation to 1,200,000; original published figures remain visible.

Published profit/loss 35, all four notes together 17 and shared exceptional-item/regulation theory 8 correspond on paper 6–7 and scheme 10–12. No balance sheet is independently requested. Every note is required.

Opening capital 20, both enterprise analyses together 20, general profit/loss 12 and solar-panel advice 8 correspond on paper 8–9 and scheme 13–15. Enterprise analyses share a single published tariff. All household and enterprise allocations are mandatory.
Trucks ledger 6, depreciation ledger 32, disposals 14 and shared theory 8 correspond on paper 10 and scheme 16–17. Both 2022 and 2023 and the refrigeration unit are required within the ledgers.

Five calculations at 10, bank advice 40 and shared share-class distinction/investment advice 10 correspond on paper 12–13 and scheme 18–21. Ordinary versus preference shares are business alternatives to compare and advise on, not alternative exam tasks.

Abridged profit/loss 20, operating reconciliation 19, cash flow 46, net-debt reconciliation 5 and shared cash-flow theory 10 correspond on paper 14–15 and scheme 22–24. Reconciliation tasks retain their own published tariffs.

All five error scenarios in journals 50, suspense account 8, no-closing-balance explanation 2, corrected profit 14, balance sheet 20 and error-of-principle theory 6 correspond on paper 16–17 and scheme 25–27.

Both high/low calculations at 11, flexible budget 13, break-even 5, safety margin 4, controllable-cost theory 4, FIFO stock 13, trading 13 and shared valuation theory 6 correspond on paper 18 and scheme 28–30. An alternative valuation method and a controllable-cost example are open responses; the scheme example list is not a printed paper choice pool.

Production 11, materials purchases 13, cash budget 34, budgeted final accounts 12 and shared variance theory 10 correspond on paper 19 and scheme 31–33. July–October are required; November workings support closing stocks. Scheme 33 heading incorrectly says four years rather than months. All solution tables upright; 34 annotations, 35 blank and 36 cover.
